title: Sample: Launch email sequence for a coaching program
summary: This is a sample entry that shows every part of a project page. Delete it from the dashboard when you add your first real project.
challenge:
The offer was strong, but the launch emails described the program in general terms. Subscribers opened them and did not know what to do next.

The goal was a clear message that made the next step obvious.
approach:
I started with three questions:

- Who is this for, in one sentence?
- What changes for them in the first month?
- What is the single action we want after each email?

Then I rewrote the sequence around one idea per email, with a story at the center of each.
before: Join our transformational program and unlock your full potential.
after: In six weeks, you will run team meetings that end with clear decisions. Spots open Monday.
